app.title: ((-)) biotimbre ((-))
app.loading_models_hint: First run downloads about 70 MB. Afterwards this is instant and works offline.

field.biotimbre_id_help: Leave empty to allocate a new one. Give an existing ID to file this sample under the same biotimbre.
field.biotimbre_id_edit_help: Editing an item never allocates a new biotimbre. Give a different existing ID to move this sample to it.
field.biotimbre_label_help: Human-readable name for this sample's biotimbre. Shared by every item filed under the same biotimbre ID.
field.taxa_help: Comma-separated tags, e.g. insecta, orthoptera. Empty means unknown.
field.band_help: Filtering already applied to this sample. Leave a bound empty if it is open.
field.filter_type_help: Kind of filter used to apply the band, e.g. Butterworth.
field.filter_order_help: Order of the filter used to apply the band.
field.speed_help: Applied before embedding. Below 1 slows down, bringing ultrasound into a model's range; above 1 speeds up. The stored audio is never changed.
field.window_help: Where this sample sits inside the original recording, in seconds.

admin.heading: Library items
admin.upload_hint: The file is copied into the library; the original is left where it is.
admin.delete_confirm: Delete item {item_id} ({taxa})? Its audio and embeddings are removed too.
admin.duplicate_warning: Byte-identical audio is already stored as item(s) {items}. Adding it again is allowed.
admin.speed_change_warning: Changing the speed recomputes this item's embeddings.
admin.no_items: The library is empty. Add a sample to begin.
admin.bulk_hint: To add many files at once, use the import-dir command.
admin.model_limits: Dashed lines mark each model's frequency limit; content above them is not seen by that model.

search.heading: Find similar samples
search.upload: Choose a recording to search with
search.upload_hint: Up to {seconds} s is searched. For a longer file, pick a segment below.
search.segment_hint: Drag to choose at most {seconds} s. The spectrogram shows the whole file, including any content above hearing range.
search.filters_hint: Applied before scoring, so results are ranked within the filtered set.

filter.biotimbre_id_help: Full biotimbre UUID. Copy it from the item detail view or a result's tooltip.

search.no_matches: No matches. Try relaxing the filters.
search.query_speed_note: Matched using the query embedded at speed {speed}.
search.cache_note: Query embeddings are reused, so changing filters is instant.
search.needs_segment: Longer than {seconds} s — choose a segment to search with.
search.no_query: Choose a recording to search with.
search.compare_hint: Play the query, then each result, to judge the match by ear.
search.marker_hint: The lighter band marks the window that produced the score.

error.query_too_long: This recording is {duration} s. Pick a segment of at most {max} s.
